description: ⛓⛓⛓ U7-swim D2 — THE PUNCH, DRIVEN. The model predicts: the chase closes at ~0.69 px/tick and stops against the player's box (`solids.push("Enemy", "Player")`); the attack is decided at `attackRange` 10 and the chase yields to it; the 11-update wind-up ends in `attackPlayer`, whose `r = 8` box off the west edge throws the player by `punchForce` 5 — punch 1 at t 44, punch 2 at t 108 against the corridor's west wall (`hits` 2). The third would kill (`hitsMax` 3), so the tape stops short of it. Authored by scripts/procgen/plan-seedling-u7-puncher.mjs.
